method.sample: SplitMix64(listing_id) mod 10 == 0; approximately 10% of listings, fixed over vintages
method.selection: Austin, Rome, Sydney: five vintages, North America/Europe/APAC; selected before outcomes
method.license: Inside Airbnb, CC BY 4.0; derived aggregate availability proxies
method.date_rule: same listing and stay date at each capture; stay date strictly after last observation
method.warning: Reopening is not cancellation; reclosure is not confirmed rebooking. No causal RNPL attribution.
